text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] prod-inference: 5xx error rate spike detected — 3.7% (5m). Threshold crossed. Paging on-call teams now.

Alice C.: I’m creating a short war room. Joining now. warroom: https://meet.redwood/warroom/1932154321 (passcode on PagerDuty thread).

Bob M.: I’m the current on-call — confirming I received the page. I’ll be primary for initial triage.

Charlie S.: I can help with model routing checks and fallback config. Triage steps: check load balancer, routing logs, and model variant fallbacks.

Alice C.: Owner assignment: Alice C. incident owner. Bob M. on-call lead. Charlie S. model lead. SRE Lead for infra support.

SRE Lead: I’ll pull infra metrics and check node health + GPU pool. Posting immediate checks: `kubectl get pods -n redwood-inference --selector=service=runtime -o wide` and `curl -s https://metrics.internal/api/errors?service=inference&window=5m`.

Bob M.: Running routing health check now. Observed increased 502s from region us-west-2, traffic spike to dedicated pool. Adding temporary circuit to route to fallback variant.

Alice C.: Status page action: we should post "Investigating" now with impact summary and ETA for next update in 15m. Draft: 
- Status: Investigating
- Impact: Some customers in us-west-2 may experience increased 5xx responses for text generation routes.
- Mitigation: Engineers are investigating and routing controls being applied.
- Next update: 15 minutes or sooner.

DevEx Bot: statuspage.update: incident=INC-1932154321 action=draft url=https://status.redwood/status/INC-1932154321

Charlie S.: Quick mitigation note: temporarily lowering max-concurrency on the affected pool and forcing model fallback for heavy requests. Pushing config now: 
```
# nginx routing override
location /v1/generate {
  proxy_set_header X-Use-Variant fallback-v2;
  proxy_pass http://inference-fallback;
}
```

Bob M.: Confirmed config pushed to canary hosts. Monitoring errors.

Alice C.: Customer notification template (short):
```
Hi <customer>,
We are investigating a service disruption affecting inference requests from some regions. You may see increased errors or latency. Our engineers are actively mitigating and we’ll update within 15 minutes.

If you’re seeing significant impact please reply and we’ll prioritize.

— Redwood Inference Incident Response
```

SRE Lead: If we escalate, we need the full list of affected customers from traffic logs. Assigning @Charlie S. to pull top-10 customers by error rate.

Charlie S.: On it. Querying logs now: `select customer_id, count(*) as errors from logs where status>=500 and service='inference' and timestamp>now()-interval '10 minutes' group by customer_id order by errors desc limit 10;`

Bob M.: Monitoring dashboards show reduced error rate after fallback but still above baseline: 1.4% (5m). I’ll keep the page open.

Alice C.: Next steps checklist:
- [ ] Status page live (Alice)
- [ ] Customer outbound draft ready (Alice)
- [ ] Model fallback & routing (Charlie/Bob)
- [ ] Infra health and nodes (SRE Lead)
- [ ] Postmortem owner assigned (to be decided)

Bob M.: Pager handoff note: If this continues beyond 2 hours, please escalate to SRE incident manager. I confirm I will be on rotation for the next 30m then handoff to Charlie S. for follow-up.

Alice C.: Confirming timeline: next update at 1932154421 (10 minutes). If critical regression happens sooner we update immediately.

incident-bot: Pager acknowledged by Bob M.. War room created. For documentation see runbook: https://confluence.redwood/infra/runbooks/inference-5xx-spike

Charlie S.: Pulling top-10 customers now, will post IDs in 5 minutes.

Alice C.: Thanks team. Keep messages concise in the war room and avoid duplicating actions. I’ll own communications and status page.

Bob M.: I’ll remain in the war room and watch metrics.

SRE Lead: Ready to take over infra escalations.

DevEx Bot: reminder: please tag `#incidents` in any customer threads and attach incident ID INC-1932154321 for tracking.

Alice C.: Closing thread here for kickoff. We’ll continue live in the war room.
